instruction: A cinematic low-angle medium-full shot of a group of friends on a sunny rooftop. From left to right: the Black man in a dark blue shirt (R6) looks up; the woman with reddish-brown hair in a white t-shirt (R1) raises her hand; the woman with brown hair in a white open shirt (R5) looks up; the woman with light brown hair in a denim vest (R3) looks up; the man with short gray hair in a gray t-shirt (R2) gestures with both hands; and the man with short blonde hair in a brown jacket and black hat (R4) looks down towards the group. Bright daylight illuminates the scene against a blue sky.

R4 looks down toward the group while R6 looks up
